title: Later Done
subtitle: 历史古迹 · 主题语境阅读
theme: 历史古迹（人与社会·历史社会与文化·历史事件与人物）
meta: 主题语境：历史古迹（人与社会·历史社会与文化·历史事件与人物）　|　核心词汇：later　|　正文 325 words　|　高三一轮复习
intro: 请阅读文章，根据上下文判断每一处 later 的位置与含义，再完成 Task 1—Task 3。
passage: ① Later, in 1984 the postman returned the envelope at the box, and everybody in the office said it was the first time anybody had done such a thing there. Three weeks on, people still spoke of that morning: before the June rains the postman had ② later returned the envelope, and nobody had asked a single question. The postman had come to the office two weeks earlier, and spoke little of the office he had left behind him.

The list for June 1978 puts it plainer. The envelope was ③ later known, and the sender who kept it had ④ later fetched it twice before the winter came; nothing in the office was ever done later in those days. The sender wrote that line himself and read it aloud once every week thereafter.

My uncle, who kept the envelope at the far box, meant something else. He returned the envelope ⑤ later at once, and nobody in the office doubted it; of all who returned it that week, he returned it ⑥ later without a word of thanks. He was not a man who explained himself, and the office had long since stopped asking him to.

By 1991 the matter had shrunk to half a line in the list. What the line asked for was that the envelope be fetched ⑦ later every week, and that whoever did it be ⑧ later careful about the whole business. Everybody laughed at the wording, and then did exactly what it said, as they always did. Everybody there knew the work had been done later.

My mother said nothing at all. In 1994 she returned the envelope ⑨ later without a word of thanks when nobody else would, and ⑩ Later, she said in 1996, that was the part the office never forgot; the list still speaks later of it. She kept the envelope in the same box for thirty years afterwards, and never once said why; the office never forgot how later it had been done.

task1.title: Task 1　语境辨义
task1.intro: 请为文中十处画线形式选择对应的用法说明。
options: A. adv. 后来（句中状语，置于助动词之后／动词之前：had later returned …，文中第 2、9 题两处）
B. adv. 后来（修饰形容词：later known）
C. adv. 稍后（评注性状语，置于句首：Later, …，文中第 1、10 题两处）
D. adv. 稍后（修饰过去分词：had later fetched it）
E. adv. 后来（句末状语：… later at once）
F. adv. 后来（句末状语：… later without a word of thanks，第 6 处）
G. adv. 稍后（被动结构中的中位状语：be fetched later）
H. adv. 稍后（修饰形容词：be later careful about the whole business）

items.q: later without a word of thanks

answers.why: later 意为“后来”，此处置于句首作评注性状语，修饰整个句子：Later, in 1984 …。
later 意为“后来”，此处置于助动词与过去分词之间修饰动词：had later returned the envelope。
later 意为“后来”，此处修饰形容词 known（为人所知）：was later known。
later 意为“稍后”，此处修饰过去分词 fetched：had later fetched it twice。
later 意为“后来”，此处置于句末修饰动词：returned the envelope later at once。
later 意为“后来”，此处亦置于句末：of all who did it that 星期, he did it later without a word of thanks。
later 意为“稍后”，被动结构 be fetched later 中，副词置于过去分词之后。
later 意为“稍后”，此处修饰形容词 careful（仔细）：be later careful about the whole business。
later 意为“后来”，1994 年母亲在无人肯做时又一次返回那件薄薄的信封，副词置于动词之后。
later 意为“稍后”，母亲 1996 年那句话以评注性状语开头：Later, …，修饰整句。

task2.title: Task 2　语境运用
task2.intro: 请把下列句子译成英文，括号里是必须用到的形式。
items: 1984 年，邮差稍后在信箱返回那件薄薄的信封；邮局里人人都说那是头一回。（Later, …）
雨季到来之前，邮差已经后来返回那件薄薄的信封。（had later returned …）
那件薄薄的信封当时后来为人所知。（later known）
保管它的那位寄信人在入冬前已经稍后把它取过两回。（had later fetched it）
叔叔后来返回那件薄薄的信封，邮局里没有一个人怀疑。（… later …）
在那个星期里做过这件事的人当中，他做得最后来。（the most later of all of them）
answers: Later, in 1984 the postman returned the envelope at the box.
Before the June rains the postman had later returned the envelope.
The sender who kept it had later fetched it twice before the winter came.
He returned the envelope later at once, and nobody in the office doubted it.
Of all who did it that week, he did it later without a word of thanks.

task3.title: Task 3　语境写作
task3.intro: 请写 5—6 个句子，至少使用 later 的 3 种不同位置（句首评注、句中、句末、被动结构中等）；至少使用下列词语中的 3 个。
answers: Later, in 1984 the postman returned the envelope, and nobody forgot it.
Before the June rains the postman had later returned the envelope.
The envelope was later known, or so the list says.
The sender had later fetched it twice before the winter came.
My mother returned the envelope later without a word of thanks when nobody else would.
